Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Bănci
We are looking for an experienced AI Quality Assurance Automation Engineer to design, build, and maintain automated testing frameworks for AI-powered solutions using Google Gemini and conversational AI technologies .
 In this role, you will be responsible for validating conversational AI experiences, complex backend data flows, and customer experience automation workflows, while ensuring high-quality and reliable production releases.
 Key Responsibilities
Design, build, and maintain automated test suites for Gemini API integrations , including multi-turn conversations, context handling, and conversational AI automation scenarios across different customer touchpoints.
Establish end-to-end testing and tracking frameworks across the technical stack, leveraging GCP Logs Explorer, BigQuery, and PostgreSQL to identify and troubleshoot issues.
Identify, investigate, and document defects, with the technical ability to determine the likely source of an issue.
Develop testing frameworks for probabilistic AI systems , including natural language understanding accuracy, entity extraction, sentiment analysis, and other AI-driven outcomes.
Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines , such as GitHub Actions, to enable continuous regression testing.
Follow established QA methodologies, automation standards, and design patterns to maintain high-quality testing frameworks.
Collaborate closely with AI developers, data engineers, and business experts to define automation benchmarks and acceptance criteria.
Take ownership of regression, smoke, performance, and security testing within a fast-paced environment with weekly releases.
Maintain and continuously improve automated test suites to support high-quality production deployments.
Take end-to-end ownership of the quality of solutions deployed to production.
 Required Qualifications
 Experience in Software QA Automation , with strong experience in Python and API test automation .
Experience testing AI/ML or Generative AI systems .
Strong programming experience in Python .
Good understanding of probabilistic systems, Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and Generative AI evaluation .
Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , particularly technologies such as Logs Explorer, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, Vertex AI, and SCRAPI.
Experience with CI/CD tools , such as GitHub Actions.
Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools, processes, and automation best practices.
Experience working within Agile/Scrum software development environments.
Degree in a technical or financial field.
 Nice to Have
Hands-on experience testing Google Gemini or other LLMs such as GPT or Claude.
Experience with CX Agent Studio or comparable conversational AI platforms .
Knowledge of automation frameworks and multi-agent testing strategies .
Experience with AI safety testing, content moderation, and Responsible AI practices .
Experience with performance and security testing .
Knowledge of German is considered a plus.
